answer: Require each agent to forge a stake-bonded identity: before joining, it locks a refundable deposit that is slashed if peers flag it as a duplicate. Newcomers start in a dim lantern phase with capped earning power until sustained honest work raises their standing, like a velvet rope that only opens after verified history. An attacker spinning up thousands of clones must fund every deposit and fake history for each one, so the cost of the clone army exceeds any reward it could extract.
